source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should you keep inputs and relevant settings similar in runs with and without a skill?

options.text: To ensure that both runs produce exactly the same wording
options.feedback: The purpose is to compare performance, not force identical text. Different wording can meet the same quality criteria.

options.text: To replace a comparison of quality with a comparison of answer length
options.feedback: Similar conditions help you interpret performance, but output length does not replace defined task-specific quality criteria.

options.text: To let successful installation serve as evidence that the skill improves quality
options.feedback: Installation makes the skill available. Comparable runs still require inspecting actual outputs to evaluate improvement.

options.text: To make differences more informative about the skill
options.feedback: When the task and conditions are comparable, observed changes provide better evidence about the added guidance.
